title: Isolate deep sub-work in sub-agents that return only a distilled summary
statement: For complex research or exploration, delegate deep work to sub-agents with clean context windows and have each return only a condensed summary (roughly 1,000-2,000 tokens), so the lead agent synthesizes results without inheriting the detailed search context.
rationale: Separation of concerns keeps the lead agent's window clean: the expensive exploration stays isolated, and only its conclusion crosses back, which scales better than one agent holding all state.
applies_when: One agent would otherwise blow its window holding all sub-results
not_when: Tasks needing tight back-and-forth where hand-off overhead dominates (prefer compaction there)
how: Give the lead agent a high-level plan and spawn sub-agents for focused subtasks
Constrain each sub-agent to return a short distilled summary, not its raw trace
Let the lead agent synthesize the summaries
check: Does each sub-agent return a bounded summary rather than its full transcript? If the lead agent sees raw sub-traces, isolation is not happening.
failure_if_absent: A single agent's window fills with exploration detail and it loses the thread of the overall task.

evidence.title: Anthropic - Effective context engineering (sub-agent architectures)
evidence.quote: returns only a condensed, distilled summary of its work (often 1,000-2,000 tokens)
